definitions.verified: strict default contract: complete_generic result accepted by the independent `symgcad verify` in a fresh process (cold run) or in the data.json audit (history)
definitions.solve_s: fresh-process wall seconds of `symgcad solve` (includes in-run ordering search, preprocessing and export), one pinned CPU, cold caches
definitions.native_s: sum over sign cases of the native GCAD process wall time (Python start, SymPy parsing, native ordering, projection, lifting); each case capped at 300 s
definitions.ratio: symGCAD solve_s / native_s; only where both complete
definitions.order: variable order of the exported result (projection eliminates from the end); H = homogeneous anchor fixed to 1 before solving
definitions.opt_in: opt-in projective contract: cell boundaries may reach +infinity inside a cell (solver.projective_sections); never counted in the strict completion count

protocol.sign_expansion: src/benchmark.rs run_campaign: (split) >/< 0 per mask, split cleared
protocol.ordering: problem's own policy: native greedy mods/t1/sotd or given order
